candidates.title: Paganel – Data migration with a receipt you can verify later
candidates.reason: Picked: the first-party Show HN description gives concrete migration inputs, transformations, validation rules and sandboxed extensions. A constrained local-file migration and verification demo is plausible for a student; enterprise scale and broad connector coverage are not established.

candidates.title: VendIQ – AI agent for vendor follow-ups and ops automation
candidates.reason: Rejected: this snapshot contains only a title and product URL, with no workflow evidence to support a factual beginner explanation.

candidates.title: Self-bench – benchmark coding agents on real-world software
candidates.reason: Rejected: meaningful evaluation depends on sandbox setup, generated tasks and model/harness comparisons; the described product also requires a person to approve each generated evaluation. A useful safe two-week MVP is less clear than Paganel's bounded migration example.

candidates.title: Cold-email filtering script for Gmail
candidates.reason: Rejected: it is a plausible small workflow, but the only performance figure is the maker's unverified personal claim and an inbox filter can misclassify wanted mail. Paganel has stronger source detail without making an unsupported accuracy claim.

candidates.title: Hedwig – open-source campaign management
candidates.reason: Rejected: the source describes cold-email campaigns, reply classification and drafts, but centers outbound campaign sending. Paganel offers a less abuse-prone operational workflow and a more bounded beginner prototype.

candidates.title: CircleIt – route visual feedback to a coding agent
candidates.reason: Rejected as duplicate: this product and workflow are already represented by the published post Route visual feedback to a coding agent.

candidates.title: Velu – check documentation for AI agents
candidates.reason: Rejected as duplicate: this documentation audit idea is already represented by the published post Check whether docs work for AI agents.

candidates.title: Kenerate – workspace for image, video and music models
candidates.reason: Rejected: this snapshot supplies only the product name and URL, so it does not establish what the product does beyond its broad title or support a particular automatable loop.

candidates.reason: Rejected: the supplied snapshot gives a title and repository link only; it does not support details about how memory changes are captured or undone.
